blocks.source: 【RPG制作講座】パーティ編成による分類
blocks.translation: [RPG Design Guides] Classifying Party Formation

blocks.source: ＲＰＧの醍醐味の一つに、様々な仲間と冒険し、力を合わせて目的を達成することがある。今回はこの『仲間』に関わるシステムである『パーティ編成』について、まとめてみる。
blocks.translation: One of the great appeals of RPGs is embarking on adventures with various companions, working together, and achieving a common goal. This time, I’ll be taking a look at the party formation system, which is closely tied to these “companions.”

blocks.source: パーティ編成とは、戦闘や冒険を行うための仲間を決定するためのシステムである。多数のキャラクターの中から自由に編成できる作品もあれば、最初から最後まで固定された仲間で編成するしかない作品もある。
blocks.translation: Party formation is a system for deciding which companions will fight and adventure alongside you. Some games let you freely form a party from a large roster of characters, while others require you to keep the same companions from beginning to end.

blocks.source: パーティ編成は、ゲームシステムやストーリーの方向性にも、大きく影響を与える要素である。
blocks.translation: Party formation is also an element that greatly influences the direction of a game’s systems and story.

blocks.source: 例えば、多数の仲間がいる作品ならば、それだけ登場人物の多い物語を考える必要があるだろうし、戦闘面でもキャラクターの差別化が必要となる。そのため、戦闘システムや成長システムについて、触れる前にパーティ編成について考えることも有意義であるように思う。
blocks.translation: For example, if a game has many companions, you will need to develop a story with a correspondingly large cast, while also differentiating the characters in combat. For that reason, I think it can be worthwhile to consider party formation before tackling the combat and character growth systems.

blocks.source: というわけで、様々な作品で使用されているパーティ編成の型を分類しながら、利点・欠点を挙げていきたい。
blocks.translation: With that in mind, I would like to classify the various party formation types used in different games and discuss their advantages and disadvantages.

blocks.source: パーティ固定型
blocks.translation: Fixed Party Type

blocks.source: ＤＱ２、ＤＱ８など、仲間キャラクターが固定されていて入替が無く、全ての仲間が戦闘に参加する編成タイプ。細かい例外はあるが、大抵の場合は序盤に特定のキャラクターでメンバーが固定されて、それ以降パーティ構成は変化しない。編成システムとしては最もシンプルである。
blocks.translation: This is a formation type, seen in games such as DQ2 and DQ8, in which the companion characters are fixed, cannot be swapped out, and all companions participate in battle. There are some minor exceptions, but in most cases the party is fixed to specific characters early in the game, and its composition does not change thereafter. This is the simplest type of formation system.

blocks.source: ３～４人程度の人数であることが多いが、ＳＲＰＧなど、ゲームシステムによっては大人数も可能である。
blocks.translation: The party usually consists of around three or four members, although some game systems, such as SRPGs, can accommodate larger parties.

blocks.source: 利点
blocks.translation: Advantages

blocks.source: シンプルで制作しやすい。
blocks.translation: Simple and easy to create.

blocks.source: メンバーが固定されている分、成長強化システムに力を入れられる。
blocks.translation: Because the members are fixed, you can devote more effort to character growth and enhancement systems.

blocks.source: 少数のキャラにじっくり焦点を当てられるため、キャラクター性を高められる。
blocks.translation: Since you can focus in depth on a small number of characters, you can develop their individual personalities more fully.

blocks.source: 欠点
blocks.translation: Disadvantages

blocks.source: パーティ編成の自由度はない。嫌いなキャラがいても引っ込めない。
blocks.translation: There is no freedom in party formation. Even if you dislike a character, you cannot bench them.

blocks.source: たくさんの仲間が登場する賑やかなシナリオには向かない。
blocks.translation: Not suited to lively stories featuring a large number of companions.

blocks.source: 新しい仲間の加入イベントで話をつなぐのは基本的手法だが、このタイプの場合は使える弾数が少ない。
blocks.translation: Using events in which new companions join the party to connect different parts of the story is a basic technique, but this type offers only a limited number of opportunities to use it.

blocks.source: 作品例
blocks.translation: Examples
DQ1, 2, and 8; FF3, 5, and 15; Mother 1 and 2

blocks.source: ブレスオブファイア５、ワイルドアームズ１、３、４
blocks.translation: Breath of Fire 5; Wild Arms 1, 3, and 4

blocks.source: ※ＦＦ５では、キャラ交代があるが、能力を完全に継承しているため、実質的にはこの型となる。
blocks.translation: ※In FF5, characters do switch out, but since their abilities are inherited completely, it is essentially this type.

blocks.source: 無駄な仲間キャラクターが登場しないため、ストーリー的にもシステム的にも、すっきりした作品になりやすい。
blocks.translation: Because no unnecessary companion characters appear, games of this type tend to have a clean, streamlined feel in both their story and systems.

blocks.source: パーティ固定＋サブキャラ型
blocks.translation: Fixed Party + Subcharacter Type

blocks.source: パーティ固定型に近いが、入れ替わりのあるサブキャラ枠が存在する。例えば、ＦＦ２（４人パーティ）ではメインの３人はずっとパーティに参加し続けるが、最後の４人目は序盤から終盤まで、ストーリー進行に応じて変動し続ける事になる。（ちなみに全部で６人いるが、その内半分は死亡退場。）
blocks.translation: This is similar to the fixed party type, but includes a subcharacter slot whose occupant changes. For example, in FF2 (a four-member party), the three main characters remain in the party throughout, while the fourth member changes according to the story’s progress from the beginning to the end of the game. (There are six characters in total, incidentally, half of whom leave the story by dying.)

blocks.source: パーティ固定型に柔軟性を持たせた型だと、思ってもらえれば良い。
blocks.translation: You can think of this as a fixed party type with added flexibility.

blocks.source: 利点
blocks.translation: Advantages

blocks.source: パーティ固定型とほぼ同じ。
blocks.translation: Almost the same as the fixed party type.

blocks.source: ストーリー上、メインメンバー以外に印象付けたいキャラがいる場合、サブキャラ枠として参加させることができる。
blocks.translation: If there are characters you want to highlight in the story besides the main members, you can have them participate through the subcharacter slot.

blocks.source: 欠点
blocks.translation: Disadvantages

blocks.source: やはり、パーティ編成の自由度は低い。
blocks.translation: Even so, there is little freedom in party formation.

blocks.source: サブキャラ枠で参加するキャラに付いては、成長させてもいなくなるので、成長強化システム上、中途半端になりやすい。
blocks.translation: Characters who participate through the subcharacter slot eventually leave, even if you have developed them, so the growth and enhancement system tends to feel incomplete.

blocks.source: プレイヤーが気に入ったサブキャラがいても、結局は去ってしまうので寂しい。
blocks.translation: Even if the player likes one of the subcharacters, it is sad that they will ultimately leave.

blocks.source: 作品例
blocks.translation: Examples

blocks.source: ＦＦ２、サガ３、ペルソナ２罪＆罰、エターナルアルカディア
blocks.translation: FF2; SaGa 3; Persona 2: Innocent Sin & Eternal Punishment; Skies of Arcadia

blocks.source: ペルソナ２については、罪・罰共に、入れ替わりが一度だけなので大人しい。こうなると、かなり上の固定型に近くなる。
blocks.translation: In Persona 2, the party changes only once in both Innocent Sin and Eternal Punishment, so the system is relatively restrained. As a result, it ends up being quite close to the fixed type described above.

blocks.source: エターナルアルカディアのように、ゲーム終盤にサブキャラ枠のキャラを自由選択できるようになっている作品もある。これならば多少は欠点を抑えられる。
blocks.translation: Some games, such as Skies of Arcadia, let you freely choose the characters in the subcharacter slots toward the end of the game. This helps mitigate the disadvantages to some extent.

blocks.source: 正直、ゲームシステム的にどっちつかずな印象は拭えないので、上の『パーティ固定型』か、下の『パーティ同行選択型』にしてしまってもよいかも。
blocks.translation: Honestly, it is hard to shake the impression that this type falls between two stools as a game system, so you might as well go with either the “Fixed Party Type” above or the “Party Companion Selection Type” below.

blocks.source: パーティ同行選択型
blocks.translation: Party Companion Selection Type

blocks.source: 多数いる仲間の中から、戦闘メンバーを選択する。かつ、仲間キャラクターは全員冒険に同行する形式。戦闘に参加しないメンバーであっても、ストーリー上の会話へは常に参加することがポイント。
blocks.translation: You choose the battle members from among a large number of companions, while all of the companion characters accompany you on the adventure. The key point is that even members who do not participate in battle always take part in story conversations.

blocks.source: 利点
blocks.translation: Advantages

blocks.source: 適度に多い仲間キャラを物語や戦闘に絡ませる事ができる。７以降のFFシリーズやテイルズオブシリーズを見れば、その長所が分かりやすい。
blocks.translation: You can involve a reasonably large number of companion characters in both the story and combat. The advantages are easy to see in the FF series from FF7 onward and the Tales series.

blocks.source: 適度にパーティ編成を考える楽しさがある。
blocks.translation: It offers a moderate amount of enjoyment from considering your party composition.

blocks.source: 欠点
blocks.translation: Disadvantages

blocks.source: 戦闘メンバーを変更すると、今まで育てていたキャラクターへの投資が無駄になる。
blocks.translation: Changing your battle members makes the investment in the characters you have been developing up to that point go to waste.

blocks.source: 作品例
blocks.translation: Examples

blocks.source: ＤＱ１１、ＦＦ７、８、Ｔ、９、１０、１２、１３、サガフロンティア１、テイルズオブシリーズ、ペルソナ３～５、軌跡シリーズなどなど……非常に多数。
blocks.translation: DQ11; FF7, 8, T, 9, 10, 12, and 13; SaGa Frontier 1; the Tales series; Persona 3–5; the Trails series; and many, many others...

blocks.source: ８人程度のパーティメンバーから３，４人の戦闘メンバーを選ぶというパターンが多い。ストーリー性とゲーム性をバランス良く両立できる。色々と便利なのか、この型に該当する作品は非常に多い。上述の型よりはさすがに手間がかかるとはいえ、目立った欠点はないので僕的にもお勧めの型。
blocks.translation: A common pattern is to choose three or four battle members from a party roster of around eight characters. This allows the story and gameplay to coexist in a well-balanced way. Perhaps because it is convenient in many respects, a great many games fall into this category. Although it does take more work than the types described above, it has no significant disadvantages, so it is also the type I recommend.

blocks.source: パーティ非同行選択型
blocks.translation: Party Non-Companion Selection Type

blocks.source: 多数の仲間キャラクターから同行するパーティメンバーを選ぶ。選ばれなかったキャラクターは同行しないので、会話イベントにも参加しない。パーティ同行選択型よりも大所帯の場合が多く、１０８人いる幻想水滸伝などはかなり極端。
blocks.translation: You choose the party members who will accompany you from among a large number of companion characters. Characters who are not chosen do not accompany you and do not participate in conversation events. The party is often larger than in the party companion selection type; Suikoden, with its 108 characters, is an extreme example.

blocks.source: 非同行メンバーの扱いは作品によって、大きく異なる。ロマサガシリーズなどは、登場イベントなどの一部を除いて、ストーリーに参加しない。……というか、同行メンバーもロクに会話しない。
blocks.translation: How non-companion members are handled varies greatly from game to game. In games such as the Romancing SaGa series, they do not participate in the story except for certain parts, such as the events in which they appear. ...Actually, even the accompanying members barely talk.

blocks.source: パーティ同行選択型もそうだが、非戦闘メンバーに経験値を割り振るかどうかは重要なポイント。強制的に特定のキャラクターが参加するイベントがあるのに、経験値を割り振らない場合は詰みやすいので注意！（例：ブレスオブファイア２）
blocks.translation: As with the party member selection type, whether to distribute experience to non-combat members is an important consideration. If there are events that force specific characters to participate but experience is not distributed to them, the player can easily get stuck, so be careful! (Example: Breath of Fire II)

blocks.source: 利点
blocks.translation: Advantages

blocks.source: パーティ同行選択型よりも、更に多い仲間キャラを物語や戦闘に絡ませることができる。
blocks.translation: Compared to the party member selection type, this allows more companion characters to be involved in the story and battles.

blocks.source: パーティ編成を考える楽しさがある。
blocks.translation: It is fun to think about party composition.

blocks.source: 欠点
blocks.translation: Disadvantages

blocks.source: 同行していない仲間キャラはイベント会話に参加できない等、ストーリー上の制約が大きい。キャラクター１人当たりの個性は薄れやすい。
blocks.translation: There are significant story-related restrictions, such as companion characters who are not accompanying the party being unable to participate in event conversations. It is also easy for each character's individuality to become less distinct.

blocks.source: 連れているメンバーによって、イベント会話を変化させる手間がかかる。
blocks.translation: Event conversations require extra work to change depending on which members are accompanying the party.

blocks.source: 同行メンバーを変更すると、今まで育てていたキャラクターへの投資が無駄になる。
blocks.translation: Changing the accompanying members makes the investment in characters you have raised up to that point go to waste.

blocks.source: 作品例
blocks.translation: Examples

blocks.source: ＤＱ７、ＦＦ６、ロマサガシリーズ、クロノトリガー、ブレスオブファイア１～３、新桃太郎伝説、幻想水滸伝シリーズ
blocks.translation: DQ VII, FF VI, the Romancing SaGa series, Chrono Trigger, Breath of Fire I–III, New Momotaro Densetsu, the Suikoden series

blocks.source: イベント時のパーティ編成が制作者にとって不明なので、仲間同士の複雑な会話を作ることは難しい。
blocks.translation: Since the party composition during events is unknown to the creator, it is difficult to create complex conversations between companions.

blocks.source: 幻想水滸伝では、イベント時に必要なキャラを強制加入させることで対応しているが、その反面に自由なパーティ編成を妨げられる状況になっている。
blocks.translation: Suikoden handles this by forcibly adding characters needed for events to the party, but this also creates situations that prevent free party composition.

blocks.source: そのため、ロマサガシリーズのように、最初から仲間キャラクターが余り喋らないタイプの方が長所を発揮しやすい傾向がある。
blocks.translation: Therefore, types in which companion characters do not talk much from the outset, such as the Romancing SaGa series, tend to make it easier to bring out this system's strengths.

blocks.source: パーティ同行選択型との境界は曖昧な部分も多いので、筆者の主観で決めている。ＦＦ６、クロノトリガーは選択しなかったキャラクターは待機状態になるが、イベントによっては絡んでくることもあるので、パーティ同行選択型に近い部分も。
blocks.translation: The boundary with the party member selection type is often unclear, so I have decided based on my own subjective judgment. In FF VI and Chrono Trigger, characters who were not selected remain on standby, but they sometimes become involved in events, so these games also have aspects close to the party member selection type.

blocks.source: ところで、１人あぶれるＤＱ７の中途半端な構成はどうにかならなかったのだろうか……。
blocks.translation: By the way, couldn't something have been done about DQ VII's awkward party composition, which leaves one person out...?

blocks.source: パーティ変動型
blocks.translation: Changing Party Type

blocks.source: ストーリー進行に応じて、次々とパーティメンバーが変化していく。
blocks.translation: The party members change one after another as the story progresses.

blocks.source: 利点
blocks.translation: Advantages

blocks.source: 制作者が比較的自由に物語を組める。仲間の離脱・死亡・再会といったインパクトのあるイベントも多数作れる。
blocks.translation: The creator has relatively broad freedom to structure the story. It is also possible to create many impactful events, such as companions leaving, dying, or reuniting.

blocks.source: プレイヤーによるスタイルの差が小さいのでバランス調整がしやすい。
blocks.translation: Since differences in player styles are small, balancing is easier.

blocks.source: 欠点
blocks.translation: Disadvantages

blocks.source: 編成の自由度はない。気に入ったキャラクターがいても最後まで連れていけるとは限らない。
blocks.translation: There is no freedom in party composition. Even if there is a character you like, you may not be able to take them with you to the end.

blocks.source: キャラクターが去る場合には、今まで育てた投資が無駄になる
blocks.translation: When a character leaves, the investment in raising them up to that point goes to waste.

blocks.source: 育てたキャラがストーリーの都合で去って行く姿を見て、誰を育てればいいのかわからなくなり、プレイヤーが疑心暗鬼に陥る。
blocks.translation: Seeing a character they raised leave for story-related reasons makes players unsure whom to raise and causes them to become suspicious and anxious.

blocks.source: 最後まで連れて行けないキャラクターに愛着を持ちづらい。
blocks.translation: It is difficult to become attached to characters who cannot be taken along to the end.

blocks.source: 作品例
blocks.translation: Examples

blocks.source: ＦＦ４、サガフロンティア２（選択型の要素もあり）、グランディア、エストポリス伝記２
blocks.translation: FF IV, SaGa Frontier 2 (also includes elements of the selection type), Grandia, Estpolis Biography II

blocks.source: サガフロンティア２の３世代に渡るストーリーはこの型でなければ、実現が難しかったものだと思うが、ゲーム性を大幅に犠牲にしてしまっている。せめて、もう少しゲームシステム的なフォローがあれば……。
blocks.translation: I think SaGa Frontier 2's story spanning three generations would have been difficult to realize without this type, but it sacrifices a great deal of gameplay as a result. If only there had been a little more support from the game systems...

blocks.source: ＤＱ４、ＦＦ１３等、『パーティ同行選択型』『パーティ非同行選択型』の作品が序盤～中盤にこの形式を取ることもある。多数のキャラクターをプレイヤーに強制的に使わせることで、変化をつけたり、キャラの紹介を行う意味がある。
blocks.translation: Some games such as DQ IV and FF XIII also use this format during the early to middle portions of the game, despite belonging to the party member selection type or party member non-participation selection type. Forcing the player to use many different characters provides variety and serves to introduce the characters.

blocks.source: あまり無秩序にパーティ編成を変えるのは、プレイヤーに取ってアンフェア。ゲームとしては欠点が多いので、正直無理にお勧めはしない。
blocks.translation: Changing the party composition too randomly is unfair to the player. Since this approach has many disadvantages as a game system, I honestly cannot recommend forcing it.

blocks.source: それでもあえてやるならば、成長システムは、ＦＦ７のマテリアやＦＦ８のＧＦのようにキャラクター自身よりも、物を成長させるタイプの装備系システムをお勧めする。あるいはパーティ全体でコストを管理するような強化システムを考案してもよいかも。
blocks.translation: Even so, if you choose to do it, I recommend an equipment-based growth system in which objects are developed rather than the characters themselves, like FF VII's Materia or FF VIII's Guardian Forces. Alternatively, you could devise an enhancement system in which costs are managed across the entire party.

blocks.source: キャラメイク型
blocks.translation: Character Creation Type

blocks.source: キャラクターの名前・職業・性別といった要素を決めて、プレイヤーの自由にパーティ編成をさせる型。
blocks.translation: The player decides elements such as each character's name, class, and gender, then freely composes the party.

blocks.source: 利点
blocks.translation: Advantages

blocks.source: プレイヤーの自由にキャラメイクできる。パーティ編成が楽しい。
blocks.translation: Players can create characters freely. Composing the party is fun.

blocks.source: メンバーが固定されている分、成長強化システムに力を入れられる。
blocks.translation: Since the members are fixed, more effort can be put into the growth and enhancement systems.

blocks.source: 欠点
blocks.translation: Disadvantages

blocks.source: 仲間にベラベラ喋らせることは難しい。キャラクター主導のシナリオは困難。
blocks.translation: It is difficult to have the companions talk at length. Character-driven scenarios are challenging.

blocks.source: 作品例
blocks.translation: Examples

blocks.source: ＤＱ３、ＤＱ９、ＦＦ１、サガ１～２
blocks.translation: DQ III, DQ IX, FF I, SaGa I–II

blocks.source: どちらかというと、システム重視の作品に向いている。かと言ってストーリーがからっきし駄目というわけでもない。上記の作品の様にうまく冒険感を出していきたい所。
blocks.translation: This type is better suited to games that emphasize systems. That does not mean the story has to be completely inadequate, though. The goal should be to effectively convey a sense of adventure, as in the works mentioned above.

blocks.source: 収集型
blocks.translation: Collection Type

blocks.source: モンスターなどの仲間を集めて、自由にパーティ編成を行う。要するにポケモン。
blocks.translation: Collect companions such as monsters and freely compose the party. In other words, Pokémon.

blocks.source: 仲間になる対象が固定したキャラクターではない所が、パーティ非同行選択型との違い。
blocks.translation: The difference from the party member non-participation selection type is that the potential companions are not fixed characters.

blocks.source: 利点
blocks.translation: Advantages

blocks.source: パーティ編成の自由度は非常に高い。
blocks.translation: There is a very high degree of freedom in party composition.

blocks.source: 仲間の収集がプレイヤーの強いモチベーションになる。
blocks.translation: Collecting companions becomes a strong motivation for the player.

blocks.source: 欠点
blocks.translation: Disadvantages

blocks.source: 仲間にベラベラ喋らせることは難しい。キャラクター主導のシナリオは困難。
blocks.translation: It is difficult to have the companions talk at length. Character-driven scenarios are challenging.

blocks.source: パーティ編成を変更する場合に、今まで育てていたキャラクターへの投資が無駄になる。
blocks.translation: When changing the party composition, the investment in characters you have raised up to that point goes to waste.

blocks.source: 作品例
blocks.translation: Examples

blocks.source: ＤＱ５～６、モンスターズ、ポケモンシリーズ、女神転生シリーズ
blocks.translation: Dragon Quest V–VI, the Monsters series, the Pokémon series, and the Shin Megami Tensei series

blocks.source: 仲間の収集システムをどのように構築するかが肝。
blocks.translation: The key is how you construct the system for collecting allies.

blocks.source: ＤＱ５～６は『パーティ非同行選択型』の要素もあり。
blocks.translation: Dragon Quest V–VI also includes elements of the “non-party-accompanying choice” type.

blocks.source: 女神転生シリーズは主人公とヒロインの２枠が固定で、後は仲魔で占めるといったパターンが多い。
blocks.translation: In the Shin Megami Tensei series, the protagonist and heroine often occupy two fixed slots, with the remaining slots filled by demon allies.

blocks.source: 喋る仲間キャラクターがいない、あるいは少ないため、基本的にはシステム重視の型である。とはいえ、ポケモンホワイト＆ブラックのように、パーティメンバーではないキャラクターとの交流を深く描くことで、ストーリー性を高めた作品も存在する。
blocks.translation: Since there are few, if any, speaking ally characters, these games are basically system-focused. That said, some games, such as Pokémon White and Black, enhance their stories by deeply depicting interactions with characters who are not party members.

blocks.source: まとめ
blocks.translation: Summary

blocks.source: 飽くまで上記は大雑把な分類である。複数の型を複合しているタイプの作品もあるし、ペルソナ１やスターオーシャンの様に選択次第で、二度と仲間にならないキャラクターがいるパターンもある。
blocks.translation: The classifications above are, at best, rough. Some games combine multiple types, while others, such as Persona 1 and Star Ocean, feature characters who may never become allies again depending on the player's choices.

blocks.source: ただ、プレイヤーの心理を考えると、仲間の入れ替わりのルールは明確にしておいたほうが無難だろう。
blocks.translation: However, considering the player's perspective, it is probably safest to make the rules for changing allies clear.

blocks.source: 『パーティ変動型』のように頻繁な入れ替わりがある場合でも、システム的な配慮が欲しいところだ。
blocks.translation: Even when allies are frequently switched out, as in the “party variation” type, some consideration should be given to the system.

blocks.source: システム重視寄りの『収集型』『キャラメイク型』。
blocks.translation: The system-focused “collection” and “character creation” types.

blocks.source: ストーリー重視寄りの『パーティ変動型』。両立の『パーティ同行選択型』。
blocks.translation: The story-focused “party variation” type. The “party-accompanying choice” type combines both.

blocks.source: ……というように、パーティ編成の型とゲームシステム＆ストーリーとの相性は非常に重要となる。作品を作り始めるに当たって、早めに方針を決めておこう。
blocks.translation: ……Thus, the compatibility between the party formation type and the game system and story is extremely important. Decide on your approach early when you begin creating your game.

texts.ＲＰＧの醍醐味の一つに、様々な仲間と冒険し、力を合わせて目的を達成することがある: One of the great appeals of RPGs is embarking on adventures with various companions, working together, and achieving a common goal. This time, I’ll be taking a look at the party formation system, which is closely tied to these “companions.”
texts.パーティ編成とは、戦闘や冒険を行うための仲間を決定するためのシステムである。多数: Party formation is a system for deciding which companions will fight and adventure alongside you. Some games let you freely form a party from a large roster of characters, while others require you to keep the same companions from beginning to end.
texts.パーティ編成は、ゲームシステムやストーリーの方向性にも、大きく影響を与える要素で: Party formation is also an element that greatly influences the direction of a game’s systems and story.
texts.例えば、多数の仲間がいる作品ならば、それだけ登場人物の多い物語を考える必要がある: For example, if a game has many companions, you will need to develop a story with a correspondingly large cast, while also differentiating the characters in combat. For that reason, I think it can be worthwhile to consider party formation before tackling the combat and character growth systems.
texts.というわけで、様々な作品で使用されているパーティ編成の型を分類しながら、利点・欠: With that in mind, I would like to classify the various party formation types used in different games and discuss their advantages and disadvantages.
texts.ＤＱ２、ＤＱ８など、仲間キャラクターが固定されていて入替が無く、全ての仲間が戦闘: This is a formation type, seen in games such as DQ2 and DQ8, in which the companion characters are fixed, cannot be swapped out, and all companions participate in battle. There are some minor exceptions, but in most cases the party is fixed to specific characters early in the game, and its composition does not change thereafter. This is the simplest type of formation system.
texts.３～４人程度の人数であることが多いが、ＳＲＰＧなど、ゲームシステムによっては大人: The party usually consists of around three or four members, although some game systems, such as SRPGs, can accommodate larger parties.
texts.メンバーが固定されている分、成長強化システムに力を入れられる。: Since the members are fixed, more effort can be put into the growth and enhancement systems.
texts.少数のキャラにじっくり焦点を当てられるため、キャラクター性を高められる。: Since you can focus in depth on a small number of characters, you can develop their individual personalities more fully.
texts.パーティ編成の自由度はない。嫌いなキャラがいても引っ込めない。: There is no freedom in party formation. Even if you dislike a character, you cannot bench them.
texts.たくさんの仲間が登場する賑やかなシナリオには向かない。: Not suited to lively stories featuring a large number of companions.
texts.新しい仲間の加入イベントで話をつなぐのは基本的手法だが、このタイプの場合は使える: Using events in which new companions join the party to connect different parts of the story is a basic technique, but this type offers only a limited number of opportunities to use it.
texts.ＤＱ１、２、８、ＦＦ３、５、１５、マザー１、２: DQ1, 2, and 8; FF3, 5, and 15; Mother 1 and 2
texts.ブレスオブファイア５、ワイルドアームズ１、３、４: Breath of Fire 5; Wild Arms 1, 3, and 4
texts.※ＦＦ５では、キャラ交代があるが、能力を完全に継承しているため、実質的にはこの型: ※In FF5, characters do switch out, but since their abilities are inherited completely, it is essentially this type.
texts.無駄な仲間キャラクターが登場しないため、ストーリー的にもシステム的にも、すっきり: Because no unnecessary companion characters appear, games of this type tend to have a clean, streamlined feel in both their story and systems.
texts.パーティ固定型に近いが、入れ替わりのあるサブキャラ枠が存在する。例えば、ＦＦ２（: This is similar to the fixed party type, but includes a subcharacter slot whose occupant changes. For example, in FF2 (a four-member party), the three main characters remain in the party throughout, while the fourth member changes according to the story’s progress from the beginning to the end of the game. (There are six characters in total, incidentally, half of whom leave the story by dying.)
texts.パーティ固定型に柔軟性を持たせた型だと、思ってもらえれば良い。: You can think of this as a fixed party type with added flexibility.
texts.パーティ固定型とほぼ同じ。: Almost the same as the fixed party type.
texts.ストーリー上、メインメンバー以外に印象付けたいキャラがいる場合、サブキャラ枠とし: If there are characters you want to highlight in the story besides the main members, you can have them participate through the subcharacter slot.
texts.やはり、パーティ編成の自由度は低い。: Even so, there is little freedom in party formation.
texts.サブキャラ枠で参加するキャラに付いては、成長させてもいなくなるので、成長強化シス: Characters who participate through the subcharacter slot eventually leave, even if you have developed them, so the growth and enhancement system tends to feel incomplete.
texts.プレイヤーが気に入ったサブキャラがいても、結局は去ってしまうので寂しい。: Even if the player likes one of the subcharacters, it is sad that they will ultimately leave.
texts.ＦＦ２、サガ３、ペルソナ２罪＆罰、エターナルアルカディア: FF2; SaGa 3; Persona 2: Innocent Sin & Eternal Punishment; Skies of Arcadia
texts.ペルソナ２については、罪・罰共に、入れ替わりが一度だけなので大人しい。こうなると: In Persona 2, the party changes only once in both Innocent Sin and Eternal Punishment, so the system is relatively restrained. As a result, it ends up being quite close to the fixed type described above.
texts.エターナルアルカディアのように、ゲーム終盤にサブキャラ枠のキャラを自由選択できる: Some games, such as Skies of Arcadia, let you freely choose the characters in the subcharacter slots toward the end of the game. This helps mitigate the disadvantages to some extent.
texts.正直、ゲームシステム的にどっちつかずな印象は拭えないので、上の『パーティ固定型』: Honestly, it is hard to shake the impression that this type falls between two stools as a game system, so you might as well go with either the “Fixed Party Type” above or the “Party Companion Selection Type” below.
texts.多数いる仲間の中から、戦闘メンバーを選択する。かつ、仲間キャラクターは全員冒険に: You choose the battle members from among a large number of companions, while all of the companion characters accompany you on the adventure. The key point is that even members who do not participate in battle always take part in story conversations.
texts.適度に多い仲間キャラを物語や戦闘に絡ませる事ができる。７以降のFFシリーズやテイ: You can involve a reasonably large number of companion characters in both the story and combat. The advantages are easy to see in the FF series from FF7 onward and the Tales series.
texts.適度にパーティ編成を考える楽しさがある。: It offers a moderate amount of enjoyment from considering your party composition.
texts.戦闘メンバーを変更すると、今まで育てていたキャラクターへの投資が無駄になる。: Changing your battle members makes the investment in the characters you have been developing up to that point go to waste.
texts.ＤＱ１１、ＦＦ７、８、Ｔ、９、１０、１２、１３、サガフロンティア１、テイルズオブ: DQ11; FF7, 8, T, 9, 10, 12, and 13; SaGa Frontier 1; the Tales series; Persona 3–5; the Trails series; and many, many others...
texts.８人程度のパーティメンバーから３，４人の戦闘メンバーを選ぶというパターンが多い。: A common pattern is to choose three or four battle members from a party roster of around eight characters. This allows the story and gameplay to coexist in a well-balanced way. Perhaps because it is convenient in many respects, a great many games fall into this category. Although it does take more work than the types described above, it has no significant disadvantages, so it is also the type I recommend.
texts.多数の仲間キャラクターから同行するパーティメンバーを選ぶ。選ばれなかったキャラク: You choose the party members who will accompany you from among a large number of companion characters. Characters who are not chosen do not accompany you and do not participate in conversation events. The party is often larger than in the party companion selection type; Suikoden, with its 108 characters, is an extreme example.
texts.非同行メンバーの扱いは作品によって、大きく異なる。ロマサガシリーズなどは、登場イ: How non-companion members are handled varies greatly from game to game. In games such as the Romancing SaGa series, they do not participate in the story except for certain parts, such as the events in which they appear. ...Actually, even the accompanying members barely talk.
texts.パーティ同行選択型もそうだが、非戦闘メンバーに経験値を割り振るかどうかは重要なポ: As with the party member selection type, whether to distribute experience to non-combat members is an important consideration. If there are events that force specific characters to participate but experience is not distributed to them, the player can easily get stuck, so be careful! (Example: Breath of Fire II)
texts.パーティ同行選択型よりも、更に多い仲間キャラを物語や戦闘に絡ませることができる。: Compared to the party member selection type, this allows more companion characters to be involved in the story and battles.
texts.パーティ編成を考える楽しさがある。: It is fun to think about party composition.
texts.同行していない仲間キャラはイベント会話に参加できない等、ストーリー上の制約が大き: There are significant story-related restrictions, such as companion characters who are not accompanying the party being unable to participate in event conversations. It is also easy for each character's individuality to become less distinct.
texts.連れているメンバーによって、イベント会話を変化させる手間がかかる。: Event conversations require extra work to change depending on which members are accompanying the party.
texts.同行メンバーを変更すると、今まで育てていたキャラクターへの投資が無駄になる。: Changing the accompanying members makes the investment in characters you have raised up to that point go to waste.
texts.ＤＱ７、ＦＦ６、ロマサガシリーズ、クロノトリガー、ブレスオブファイア１～３、新桃: DQ VII, FF VI, the Romancing SaGa series, Chrono Trigger, Breath of Fire I–III, New Momotaro Densetsu, the Suikoden series
texts.イベント時のパーティ編成が制作者にとって不明なので、仲間同士の複雑な会話を作るこ: Since the party composition during events is unknown to the creator, it is difficult to create complex conversations between companions.
texts.幻想水滸伝では、イベント時に必要なキャラを強制加入させることで対応しているが、そ: Suikoden handles this by forcibly adding characters needed for events to the party, but this also creates situations that prevent free party composition.
texts.そのため、ロマサガシリーズのように、最初から仲間キャラクターが余り喋らないタイプ: Therefore, types in which companion characters do not talk much from the outset, such as the Romancing SaGa series, tend to make it easier to bring out this system's strengths.
texts.パーティ同行選択型との境界は曖昧な部分も多いので、筆者の主観で決めている。ＦＦ６: The boundary with the party member selection type is often unclear, so I have decided based on my own subjective judgment. In FF VI and Chrono Trigger, characters who were not selected remain on standby, but they sometimes become involved in events, so these games also have aspects close to the party member selection type.
texts.ところで、１人あぶれるＤＱ７の中途半端な構成はどうにかならなかったのだろうか……: By the way, couldn't something have been done about DQ VII's awkward party composition, which leaves one person out...?
texts.ストーリー進行に応じて、次々とパーティメンバーが変化していく。: The party members change one after another as the story progresses.
texts.制作者が比較的自由に物語を組める。仲間の離脱・死亡・再会といったインパクトのある: The creator has relatively broad freedom to structure the story. It is also possible to create many impactful events, such as companions leaving, dying, or reuniting.
texts.プレイヤーによるスタイルの差が小さいのでバランス調整がしやすい。: Since differences in player styles are small, balancing is easier.
texts.編成の自由度はない。気に入ったキャラクターがいても最後まで連れていけるとは限らな: There is no freedom in party composition. Even if there is a character you like, you may not be able to take them with you to the end.
texts.キャラクターが去る場合には、今まで育てた投資が無駄になる: When a character leaves, the investment in raising them up to that point goes to waste.
texts.育てたキャラがストーリーの都合で去って行く姿を見て、誰を育てればいいのかわからな: Seeing a character they raised leave for story-related reasons makes players unsure whom to raise and causes them to become suspicious and anxious.
texts.最後まで連れて行けないキャラクターに愛着を持ちづらい。: It is difficult to become attached to characters who cannot be taken along to the end.
texts.ＦＦ４、サガフロンティア２（選択型の要素もあり）、グランディア、エストポリス伝記: FF IV, SaGa Frontier 2 (also includes elements of the selection type), Grandia, Estpolis Biography II
texts.サガフロンティア２の３世代に渡るストーリーはこの型でなければ、実現が難しかったも: I think SaGa Frontier 2's story spanning three generations would have been difficult to realize without this type, but it sacrifices a great deal of gameplay as a result. If only there had been a little more support from the game systems...
texts.ＤＱ４、ＦＦ１３等、『パーティ同行選択型』『パーティ非同行選択型』の作品が序盤～: Some games such as DQ IV and FF XIII also use this format during the early to middle portions of the game, despite belonging to the party member selection type or party member non-participation selection type. Forcing the player to use many different characters provides variety and serves to introduce the characters.
texts.あまり無秩序にパーティ編成を変えるのは、プレイヤーに取ってアンフェア。ゲームとし: Changing the party composition too randomly is unfair to the player. Since this approach has many disadvantages as a game system, I honestly cannot recommend forcing it.
texts.それでもあえてやるならば、成長システムは、ＦＦ７のマテリアやＦＦ８のＧＦのように: Even so, if you choose to do it, I recommend an equipment-based growth system in which objects are developed rather than the characters themselves, like FF VII's Materia or FF VIII's Guardian Forces. Alternatively, you could devise an enhancement system in which costs are managed across the entire party.
texts.キャラクターの名前・職業・性別といった要素を決めて、プレイヤーの自由にパーティ編: The player decides elements such as each character's name, class, and gender, then freely composes the party.
texts.プレイヤーの自由にキャラメイクできる。パーティ編成が楽しい。: Players can create characters freely. Composing the party is fun.
texts.仲間にベラベラ喋らせることは難しい。キャラクター主導のシナリオは困難。: It is difficult to have the companions talk at length. Character-driven scenarios are challenging.
texts.ＤＱ３、ＤＱ９、ＦＦ１、サガ１～２: DQ III, DQ IX, FF I, SaGa I–II
texts.どちらかというと、システム重視の作品に向いている。かと言ってストーリーがからっき: This type is better suited to games that emphasize systems. That does not mean the story has to be completely inadequate, though. The goal should be to effectively convey a sense of adventure, as in the works mentioned above.
texts.モンスターなどの仲間を集めて、自由にパーティ編成を行う。要するにポケモン。: Collect companions such as monsters and freely compose the party. In other words, Pokémon.
texts.仲間になる対象が固定したキャラクターではない所が、パーティ非同行選択型との違い。: The difference from the party member non-participation selection type is that the potential companions are not fixed characters.
texts.パーティ編成の自由度は非常に高い。: There is a very high degree of freedom in party composition.
texts.仲間の収集がプレイヤーの強いモチベーションになる。: Collecting companions becomes a strong motivation for the player.
texts.パーティ編成を変更する場合に、今まで育てていたキャラクターへの投資が無駄になる。: When changing the party composition, the investment in characters you have raised up to that point goes to waste.
texts.ＤＱ５～６、モンスターズ、ポケモンシリーズ、女神転生シリーズ: Dragon Quest V–VI, the Monsters series, the Pokémon series, and the Shin Megami Tensei series
texts.仲間の収集システムをどのように構築するかが肝。: The key is how you construct the system for collecting allies.
texts.ＤＱ５～６は『パーティ非同行選択型』の要素もあり。: Dragon Quest V–VI also includes elements of the “non-party-accompanying choice” type.
texts.女神転生シリーズは主人公とヒロインの２枠が固定で、後は仲魔で占めるといったパター: In the Shin Megami Tensei series, the protagonist and heroine often occupy two fixed slots, with the remaining slots filled by demon allies.
texts.喋る仲間キャラクターがいない、あるいは少ないため、基本的にはシステム重視の型であ: Since there are few, if any, speaking ally characters, these games are basically system-focused. That said, some games, such as Pokémon White and Black, enhance their stories by deeply depicting interactions with characters who are not party members.
texts.飽くまで上記は大雑把な分類である。複数の型を複合しているタイプの作品もあるし、ペ: The classifications above are, at best, rough. Some games combine multiple types, while others, such as Persona 1 and Star Ocean, feature characters who may never become allies again depending on the player's choices.
texts.ただ、プレイヤーの心理を考えると、仲間の入れ替わりのルールは明確にしておいたほう: However, considering the player's perspective, it is probably safest to make the rules for changing allies clear.
texts.『パーティ変動型』のように頻繁な入れ替わりがある場合でも、システム的な配慮が欲し: Even when allies are frequently switched out, as in the “party variation” type, some consideration should be given to the system.
texts.ストーリー重視寄りの『パーティ変動型』。両立の『パーティ同行選択型』。: The story-focused “party variation” type. The “party-accompanying choice” type combines both.
texts.……というように、パーティ編成の型とゲームシステム＆ストーリーとの相性は非常に重: ……Thus, the compatibility between the party formation type and the game system and story is extremely important. Decide on your approach early when you begin creating your game.
